standard.summary: 训练中按 adapter rank 重要性更新稳定
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Updates by adapter-rank importance during training, which keeps things stable.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练中按 adapter rank 重要性更新稳定 mask。只做逻辑 mask，不改变 tensor shape 或 optimizer state。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: During training, updates a stable mask based on adapter rank importance. Logic mask only — tensor shapes and optimizer state are untouched. Off by default.
